setup: This is a conversion between a mixed number and an improper fraction, which are two ways of writing the same amount.

steps.say: To turn a mixed number into an improper fraction, turn the whole part into [[den]]s first: [[whole]] × [[den]] = [[scaled]].
Then add the existing top on top of that: [[scaled]] + [[num]] = [[improper]].

answer: So the improper fraction is $\frac{[[improper]]}{[[den]]}$. Going the other way, divide [[improper]] by [[den]]: the quotient is [[whole]] with [[rem]] left over, so it is $[[whole]] \frac{[[rem]]}{[[den]]}$.
